newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-KIPKETER SHATTERS OWN INDOOR WORLD RECORD.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-KIPKETER SHATTERS OWN INDOOR WORLD RECORD.

text.p: Wilson Kipketer shattered his own world indoor record when he led from start to finish in the men's 800 metres final on the last day of the world championships on Sunday.
Kipketer took more than a second off his previous mark when he clocked one minute 42.67 seconds.

The 26-year-old Dane, who was not allowed to compete for his adopted country at last year's Atlanta Olympics, took nearly a second off the previous record in the opening heat on Friday when he clocked one minute 43.96 seconds.
On Sunday he obviously had the world record in his sights again, blasting through the first 200 metres in 24.22 seconds, the 800 in 50.22 and coming up to the bell in one minute 16.49.
Kipketer, born and raised in Kenya, has lived in Denmark since 1990. He was the world outdoor champion in 1995 and was ranked number one in the world last year.
